item.title: Dot Link 0.5.3
item.description: - With Polar sharing on, Dot can pick up on a casual remark about sleep, a long walk or a racing heart and use the relevant records without you having to ask. - When you talk about a week of sleep, Dot can sum up what stood out and tell recorded sleep apart from the full overnight window. - Dot can offer a short check-in when an activity change matters to your plans, and stay quiet about routine updates or something you have already discussed.
